name: backup-mcp
description: Read-only tools for inspecting backup infrastructure freshness, job completion status, and recovery points.

tools.name: get_backup_status
tools.description: Retrieves the latest execution status and RPO freshness for a given backup job or protected host.

target_name.description: Name of the VM, database, or server to verify backup status for.

tools.name: list_backup_jobs
tools.description: Lists all configured backup jobs and their last run results (Success, Warning, Failed).

tools.name: get_job_history
tools.description: Retrieves historical execution logs and durations for a specific backup job.

job_name.description: Identifier or name of the backup job.

limit.description: Number of recent historical runs to return.
